title: Echidna eating ants
author: Cazz
changes: Wild short-beaked echidna (Tachyglossus aculeatus) snuffling and digging into an ant nest at Mulligans Flat, Canberra: soft crackles and snuffles of soil and leaf litter (echidnas have no real call). Trimmed to 1.00–3.90 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 150 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Audio track of the video. The 150 Hz high-pass removes measured wind rumble, which made up most of the low-frequency energy.
